# Celvesta

> Celvesta is a hosted Class 4 softswitch for wholesale carriers, VoIP resellers, call centers and telecom startups. Each customer gets their own dedicated switch on a private server, branded with their own logo and fully managed by Celvesta: installation, updates, daily backups and monitoring. Plans are flat monthly prices with unlimited minutes, sized by concurrent calls and calls per second.

Key facts:
- Plans: Starter $149/month (up to 200 concurrent calls, 20 CPS), Business $349/month (up to 500 concurrent calls, 50 CPS), Carrier $649/month (1,000 concurrent calls, 100 CPS, dedicated bare-metal server, priority support; extra capacity in 500-call blocks at $250/month each, +25 CPS; custom quote above 2,000 calls). Yearly billing gives 2 months free.
- Every customer runs on a separate server; servers are never shared between customers.
- Every plan includes online top-ups for the operator's own customers (card through the operator's own Stripe account, or USDT on TRC20 and BEP20) and low-balance alerts by email and Telegram.
- Features include least-cost routing, real-time billing, CDRs and reports, a branded admin panel and customer portal, and STIR/SHAKEN support.
- Every plan includes free onboarding (customers, vendors and routes set up with you) and 2 days of free test traffic before you commit. The one-time setup fee covers installation and branding.
- Support hours are on US Eastern time. Celvesta never asks for payment by chat; invoices are only sent from billing@celvesta.com.
